plan.status: retrospective analysis; not a preregistration of previously unseen outcomes
plan.interval: two-sided 95% percentile; exact McNemar tests reported separately, exploratory and unadjusted
plan.duplicate_policy: Within each immutable cohort, endpoint, item and condition, retain the first serialized record BEFORE checking validity. Never select a later parseable or favorable answer. Previously deduplicated inputs cannot reconstruct upstream retry selection.
plan.pair_policy: Require valid binary outputs, identical initial labels and ground truth, correct opponent direction where logged, identical known Pass-1 IDs, identical normalized full requests where available. Missing provenance remains unverified, never imputed as a historical record identifier.
plan.request_normalization: Remove only the expert source-description sentence from the expert request. Compare all remaining messages and request fields byte-for-byte after canonical JSON serialization. Compare recorded served model and provider where both are available.
plan.cluster_policy: Resample source documents with replacement within each domain, preserving all questions in each document and fixed original domain weights. No cross-model pooling is performed.
plan.missingness: Invalid outputs are not non-reversals. Report complete cases and worst-case bounded pair differences on observed eligible candidate pairs; absent historical attempted records remain unknown.
plan.rationale_policy: Saved stimulus hashes are reconstructable references, not proof of delivered prompts. Only retained full requests can verify identical delivered rationale/context.
plan.historical_outputs: read-only; all revised estimates go in a separate directory
